_comment: THE FIVE SAVES CONVERSIONCHECK PUTS ON THE BLOCK GRID (0.7.66, batch M2; the project's spec-grid.md 2.6).
Each entry is one save's land, copied key for key from the save file: its format, the build that wrote it,
its month, the fields a save from before 0.7.56 derives its world's seed from (cityName, foundingCash,
landOwned, month), and its ground - a format-31 save's landCentre, landLanes, landPurchases and depletion,
an older save's landOwned, ironDeposits and ironReserveTonnes. minesCommitted is not a save key: it is the
Iron Mines standing and ordered when the save is loaded (Game.minesCommitted()), counted from its buildings.
A save whose ground is another's, key for key, names it in landAs (Jerus's slot 3 holds his autosave's land).
jerus-1007a: Jerus's live city, written by 0.7.63 (fields held site by site); jerus-old: his older city,
0.7.49; city600 and city2400: the research cities, 0.7.38. Nothing in the game reads this file.
FROZEN BY 0.7.66'S LANE CODE (batch M3, which removes it): cityLand is what CityLand read from each format-31
save - its totals' bits, its frontiers, and its owned plots within reach (count and an FNV-1a hash, row by row) -
which ConversionCheck 1 holds LegacyLand to; j1bKm2 is J1b's centre for each older save (all, dry, fresh, sea,
forest km2), which section 5 prints the drawn books against; wholeFieldCity is section 4's city, founded on the
default world, bought evenly round the forty lanes and one lane pushed to a field's centre, as a format-31 save
of this build would hold it (written by M3Freeze in scratch-m3/probe).
